### Load data

###### R / tidyverse

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
library(tidyverse)
diamonds
band_members
band_instruments
```
:::


###### R / data.table

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
library(data.table)
diamonds.dt <- as.data.table(diamonds)
band_members.dt <- as.data.table(band_members)
band_instruments.dt <- as.data.table(band_instruments)
```
:::


###### Python / Polars

::: {.cell}

```{.python .cell-code}
import polars as pl
diamonds_polars = pl.from_pandas(r.diamonds)
band_members_polars = pl.from_pandas(r.band_members)
band_instruments_polars = pl.from_pandas(r.band_instruments)
```
:::
